tips.text: Buy extra Carapace relics from Varzia; it is the Rare part in every one of them and the usual bottleneck.
Bank Aya before Varzia's window opens; neither Aya nor relics you hold expire when her stock rotates.
Refine Rare and Uncommon relics to Radiant and leave Common relics Intact; Radiant lowers a Common's odds.
Run Radiant relics in a squad that all bring the same relic to boost the Rare odds.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
Free two Companion slots before claiming; one is for the Prime and one for the Burst Laser Prime it comes with.
